description: What a resource depends on, or what depends on it. Headless, it updates .godot's class list and starts autoloads.

depth.description: forward: levels to follow. Default unlimited, which can be very large. Try 2 or 3.

direction.description: forward: what this resource loads, as a tree. reverse: every file that refers to it. Default forward.

fileTypes.description: reverse: extensions of the files to read, such as ["gd", "tscn"]. "godot" is project.godot. Default every kind that names a resource.

includeBuiltin.description: forward: also list files whose path starts res://., such as those under .godot. Default false.

resourcePath.description: File inside the project, such as "sprites/hero.png" or "materials/steel.tres".

name: project_dependencies
title: Project dependencies
